verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance sells registered-agent service with published pricing and says customers can instantly access state forms pre-filled with its registered agent address, which covers the core need of getting an address for a filing quickly. The evidence does not show an explicit online checkout flow, does not state that the exact agent name is supplied, and does not confirm same-day delivery after purchase. Missing for 10: documented online self-serve purchase, explicit provision of the exact agent name, a same-day turnaround guarantee, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can buy registered-agent service online and get the exact agent name and street address my formation or change filing needs the same day
